basic_info.description: Luxe 3-level Designer View Home! This completely rebuilt, like-new 3-level residence offers an extraordinary blend of modern design, expansive living space, & sweeping views of the San Francisco Bay. Thoughtfully crafted with 2,800 square feet, the home features 4 spacious bedrooms, 4.5 designer bathrooms, multiple decks, and a beautifully landscaped backyard, ideal for both entertaining & everyday living. Set in the sought-after view side of Miraloma Park, this home combines the best of contemporary luxury, privacy, & convenient urban access. Amenities include gourmet Chef's kitchen with oversized center island, premium appliances, & beautiful stone/tile. Expansive living areas with open-concept living/dining rooms with fireplaces, a 180-degree view deck, and exceptional natural light throughout. Each of the 4 bedrooms is designed as a luxurious primary suite, complete with a beautiful en suite spa-like bathroom. Fully landscaped outdoor areas include large deck and a level lawn area, ideal for outdoor entertaining, gardening, or family playtime. All-new construction quality, new windows, doors, tile, fixtures, plumbing, and electrical throughout move-in ready with no compromises. Prime location with easy access to Muni lines, shopping centers, major freeways.
